![Dairy Free Vanilla Cupcakes - Eight Forest Lane](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/06230604-1150-0139-0000-b6897a33fb3a:4)
Baking dairy-free cupcakes is easy by `swapping traditional dairy for plant-based alternatives like soy, almond, or oat milk, and using vegan butter or neutral oils` . You can make delicious, moist dairy-free cupcakes by following simple, allergy-friendly recipes.[](https://eightforestlane.com/my-best-vanilla-cupcake-recipe/) [[1]](https://eightforestlane.com/my-best-vanilla-cupcake-recipe/)[[2]](https://jessicacox.com.au/recipe/2024/08/08/vanilla-lemon-cupcakes-w-frosting-gluten-dairy-free/)[[3]](https://eatwithclarity.com/dairy-free-cupcakes/)[[4]](https://myfoodbook.com.au/recipes/show/gluten-free-dairy-free-cupcakes)[[5]](https://eightforestlane.com/vegan-vanilla-cupcakes/)

Easy One-Bowl Dairy-Free Vanilla Cupcakes

This recipe yields 12 light and fluffy cupcakes without missing out on traditional flavor.[[1]](https://cooking.nytimes.com/recipes/1024390-vanilla-cupcakes)[[2]](https://cakesbylynz.com/vanilla-cupcake-recipe-tutorial/)

Ingredients

**For the cupcakes:** 

- 1 cup dairy-free milk (such as soy or oat)
- 1 tbsp white vinegar or apple cider vinegar (this creates a dairy-free buttermilk)
- 1 ¾ cups all-purpose flour (or gluten-free 1-to-1 blend)
- 1 tsp baking powder
- ¼ tsp baking soda
- 1 cup sugar
- ⅓ cup neutral oil (canola or vegetable oil)
- 1 ½ tsp vanilla extract
- A pinch of salt[](https://eightforestlane.com/my-best-vanilla-cupcake-recipe/) [[1]](https://eightforestlane.com/my-best-vanilla-cupcake-recipe/)[[2]](https://eightforestlane.com/vegan-vanilla-cupcakes/)[[3]](https://eatwithclarity.com/dairy-free-cupcakes/)[[4]](https://jessicacox.com.au/recipe/2024/08/08/vanilla-lemon-cupcakes-w-frosting-gluten-dairy-free/)[[5]](https://www.theannoyedthyroid.com/2011/12/14/egg-nut-and-dairy-free-cupcakes/)

**For the dairy-free buttercream:** 

- ½ cup dairy-free butter block (softened)
- 2 cups powdered/icing sugar
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- 1-2 tbsp dairy-free milk[](https://jessicacox.com.au/recipe/2024/08/08/vanilla-lemon-cupcakes-w-frosting-gluten-dairy-free/) [[1]](https://jessicacox.com.au/recipe/2024/08/08/vanilla-lemon-cupcakes-w-frosting-gluten-dairy-free/)[[2]](https://eatwithclarity.com/dairy-free-cupcakes/)[[3]](https://glutenfreealice.com/2023/06/19/vanilla-cupcakes-gluten-free-dairy-free/)[[4]](https://www.theannoyedthyroid.com/2011/12/14/egg-nut-and-dairy-free-cupcakes/)

Instructions

1. **Preheat and Prep:** Preheat your oven to 180°C (160°C fan-forced) and line a 12-hole muffin tin with paper liners.[](https://eightforestlane.com/vegan-vanilla-cupcakes/) [[1]](https://eightforestlane.com/vegan-vanilla-cupcakes/)[[2]](https://mykidslickthebowl.com/dairy-free-cupcakes/)
2. **Make the Buttermilk:** In a small bowl, whisk the dairy-free milk and vinegar together. Let it sit for 5-10 minutes to curdle slightly.[](https://eightforestlane.com/vegan-vanilla-cupcakes/) [[1]](https://eightforestlane.com/vegan-vanilla-cupcakes/)[[2]](https://www.whitakerschocolates.com/blogs/blog/gluten-free-vegan-chocolate-cupcakes-recipe-uk)
3. **Mix Wet Ingredients:** In a large bowl, whisk the sugar, oil, vanilla extract, and your milk-vinegar mixture.[[1]](https://eatwithclarity.com/dairy-free-cupcakes/)
4. **Add Dry Ingredients:** Sift in the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Gently mix until just combined—do not overmix.[](https://eightforestlane.com/vegan-vanilla-cupcakes/) [[1]](https://eightforestlane.com/vegan-vanilla-cupcakes/)
5. **Bake:** Divide the batter evenly among your cupcake liners (about 2 3 two-thirds 2 3 full). Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until a skewer inserted in the center comes out clean.[](https://www.theannoyedthyroid.com/2011/12/14/egg-nut-and-dairy-free-cupcakes/) [[1]](https://www.theannoyedthyroid.com/2011/12/14/egg-nut-and-dairy-free-cupcakes/)[[2]](https://www.jomeisfinefoods.com/blogs/recipes/matcha-goodness-cupcakes)[[3]](https://blackallergymama.com/delightfully-allergy-friendly-vanilla-cupcakes-gluten-and-dairy-free/)
6. **Cool and Frost:** Let them cool completely on a wire rack. For the frosting, beat the dairy-free butter until creamy, then slowly add in the powdered sugar, vanilla, and splash of dairy-free milk until fluffy.[](https://www.theannoyedthyroid.com/2011/12/14/egg-nut-and-dairy-free-cupcakes/) [[1]](https://www.theannoyedthyroid.com/2011/12/14/egg-nut-and-dairy-free-cupcakes/)

Where to Buy Dairy-Free Cupcakes If you are located in Sydney and would prefer to purchase ready-made dairy-free treats, local bakeries and dedicated vegan shops offer delivery and pickup:

- **Cupcake Central:** Offers a wide range of premium plant-based, dairy-free, and egg-free cupcakes with delivery.
- **Food Voyageur:** Provides freshly baked, dairy-free, and egg-free cupcakes delivered locally.
- **[Little Cupcakes](https://www.littlecupcakes.com.au/):** Highly-rated shop offering handcrafted mini and standard vegan cupcakes.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:6059745028083653114,catalogid:13806717422595556526,gpcid:16330884522511184281&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:3552531255805454554&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:11143808754584701252,catalogid:1237370608099788764&ibp=oshop)[[4]](https://foodvoyageur.com/collections/cupcakes-melbourne)[[5]](https://www.theannoyedthyroid.com/2011/12/14/egg-nut-and-dairy-free-cupcakes/)

*Note: Always double-check ingredient labels on products and pre-made decorations (like sprinkles) to ensure they are 100% free of dairy derivatives or cross-contamination.* [](https://www.arlafoods.co.uk/recipes/lactose-free-cupcakes/) [[1]](https://www.arlafoods.co.uk/recipes/lactose-free-cupcakes/)[[2]](https://glutenfreealice.com/2023/06/19/vanilla-cupcakes-gluten-free-dairy-free/)
